source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将翻出，静压将开裂
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC39 after EP02 SC38 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where truth is nearly breaking out and the white-clothed woman's restraint is nearly opening into the next threshold: Keshadu's conclusion is nearly impossible to contain, Shisilang's fury is a breath from visible rupture, Tuobaye is nearly fully emptied out, and the white-clothed woman's still pressure is at the lip of a visible split.
title: 真相将翻出，静压将开裂

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC38 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC38 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将破面，十四郎怒线欲断，拓拔野几近空尽，白衣女子的静压已到将翻开边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推进到真正外裂前的临界状态。科沙度的判断几乎已经压不回去，十四郎的怒势也只差一下就会断线，拓拔野几乎完全见空，而白衣女子的静压来到马上要开裂的边缘。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将破面与将翻开推进到真正外显裂开前的门槛，为明确出手、揭露或局面失控做直接引爆。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and controlled until the actual break source beat; do not spend the full overturn too early.
Keshadu should feel almost unable to prevent truth from breaking into shared fact.
Shisilang remains unstable and one breath from visible rupture.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: truth nearly breaking outward, rupture-edge fury, almost-empty endurance, and splitting restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
